customTargets.AuthorEditorSyncAcrossFormatsHelpText::i: Tindakan ini langsung menyinkronkan buku yang dipantau oleh penulis yang memenuhi syarat di berbagai format. Proses ini tidak memulai pencarian.
customTargets.AuthorEditorSyncAcrossFormatsHelpText::z: 此操作会立即跨格式同步符合条件的作者所监控的书籍。此操作不会触发搜索。
customTargets.AutoAddMissingAuthorsConfirmMessage::pt-: O Chaptarr pode adicionar autores ausentes identificados pelo servidor a partir dos downloads concluídos na sua categoria do Chaptarr e depois importar esses arquivos. Os novos autores serão colocados na pasta raiz padrão que você escolher. Se houver apenas uma pasta raiz para esse tipo de mídia, o Chaptarr a usará automaticamente.

rationalesByOrdinal.201: The current Spanish says “new user” and omits the account-name meaning; the selected wording explicitly says “username.”
rationalesByOrdinal.202: The current clauses make the product appear to enable authentication. The selected wording says the application now requires authentication and preserves the local-address exception.
rationalesByOrdinal.207: Corrects malformed word order around the media-type root folder and keeps both placeholders. Spanish retains the existing polite register; Vietnamese localizes “series” with the catalog term.
rationalesByOrdinal.208: Adds the missing “or” to the alternative label in its caller context.
rationalesByOrdinal.209: Corrects malformed word order and preserves the author, folder, book, and media-type meaning. Spanish retains the existing polite register.
rationalesByOrdinal.210: Uses the natural Chinese book counter with the existing count placeholder and balanced punctuation.
rationalesByOrdinal.212: Clarifies that eligible authors’ monitored books are synced across formats and that the action does not start a search. The Indonesian and Simplified Chinese refinements avoid awkward constructions in both submitted candidates.
rationalesByOrdinal.217: Restores the omitted “name” in the Vietnamese field label.
rationalesByOrdinal.220: Replaces literal “book rows,” “grab,” and unmonitor wording with the actual monitored-book automation behavior. The selected text retains searching, downloading/upgrading, the pause for this media type, and unchanged individual book selections.
rationalesByOrdinal.224: Places the query as the search target and the provider as its source, matching the UI’s provider-search prompt.
rationalesByOrdinal.228: Replaces transliterated English with a concise Hindi action label.
rationalesByOrdinal.229: States the auto-add action and its author scope in Hindi.
rationalesByOrdinal.230: Corrects “missing” authors and the queue-import condition; Traditional Chinese uses the queue term rather than “column import.”
rationalesByOrdinal.231: Makes the server-matched author relationship and completed-download condition clear, and identifies the localized Root Folders setting.
rationalesByOrdinal.232: Replaces transliterated English with the Hindi auto-add action while retaining “missing authors.”
rationalesByOrdinal.233: Clarifies that the server matches missing authors from completed downloads in the Chaptarr category, then preserves import and default-root behavior.
rationalesByOrdinal.234: Uses a natural enable-auto-add title and keeps the localized action and author scope.
rationalesByOrdinal.235: Corrects the retry-import instruction and the completed-download/server-match relationship while retaining the one-root-folder fallback.
rationalesByOrdinal.239: Replaces the literal technical “push” calque with the natural send action for metadata.
rationalesByOrdinal.241: The caller is a checkbox in failed-download handling. The selected wording describes redownloading when a download fails instead of reporting a failed redownload.
rationalesByOrdinal.242: The caller is the nested interactive-search checkbox. The selected wording describes retrying after failure and preserves the distinction from other sources.
rationalesByOrdinal.243: Clarifies that the download of a release chosen or obtained from Interactive Search failed, which triggers searching for and attempting another release.
rationalesByOrdinal.245: The source describes stopping monitoring after a book is deleted; it does not say the book itself is disabled or unmanaged.
rationalesByOrdinal.246: The caller uses “Automatic” as an option label; the selected Chinese adjective means automatic rather than automation.
rationalesByOrdinal.248: Uses the established notion of switching/changing between releases, rather than an ambiguous English borrowing or replacement-only wording.
